description.top: How much water is on Earth? About 370 quintillion gallons, yet only 0.01% sits in lakes and rivers. Here's where the rest is, and how much of it we can use.
description.body: Earth's water budget in under four minutes: the oceans, fresh water frozen in glaciers and ice caps, groundwater and aquifers, and how the water cycle moves water between them. It answers what percentage of Earth's water is fresh and how much drinkable water there is on Earth.
